newsitem.title: USA: Mass. House winner to be named late in November.
newsitem.headline: Mass. House winner to be named late in November.

text.p: The winner of one congressional race in Massachusetts is unlikely to be known until after Thanksgiving, a spokesman for the Massachusetts Secretary of State said Wednesday.
A recount has been ordered in the 6th congressional district where Democratic challenger John Tierney was leading Republican incumbent Peter Torkildsen by 366 votes out of some 270,000 ballots cast.
But the recount will not be held until an estimated 185 overseas ballots are received and counted, John McCarthy, a spokesman for Secretary of State William Glavin, said.

"This is a federal election which means overseas ballots have up to 10 days to be received and counted," he said. "We're not expecting the results before Thanksgiving (Nov. 28). We're projecting to know about Nov. 30."

If Tierney is able to hold onto his narrow margin it would be only the second time in the state's history that its House delegation has been all Democratic. Massachusetts' other Republican congressman, Peter Blute, was defeated Tuesday by Democrat Jim McGovern.
